input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: migrate all server routes to transport-agnostic Handler shape

Converts every Express route handler to the (ctx: RequestCtx) => Promise<Response>
interface so they can run in both the Express/Node server and Cloudflare Workers
via Hono. Key changes:

- server/src/http/types.ts: full BoardActor | AgentActor discriminated union with
  all authz fields (source, isInstanceAdmin, companyIds, memberships, runId)
- server/src/http/express-adapter.ts: expressHandler() populates all actor fields
- server/src/routes/authz.ts: AuthzReq structural interface accepted by all authz
  helpers — satisfiable by both Express Request and RequestCtx
- server/src/routes/workspace-command-authz.ts, workspace-runtime-service-authz.ts:
  updated to accept AuthzReq instead of Express Request
- All 25 route files migrated: handlers wrapped with expressHandler() for Node,
  inline Express middleware wrappers removed, assertInstanceAdmin/assertBoardOrgAccess
  moved inside Handler functions
- packages/deploy-cloudflare: R2-backed run-log and workspace-op-log stores, sidecar
  client for delegating plugin/workspace ops, CF company-skills and agent-instructions
  services, updated Hono worker entry with correct actor shape

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit all route migrations and Cloudflare service files
